scope: Independent asset-level frame/sequence review of corrected rabbit gait; not final game integration, user acceptance, or a validated fun study.
reviewedHumanDefect: Screenshot 2026-10-27 at 10.19.38.png: torso upright, forepaws hanging, hind-only bipedal silhouette.
visualObservations: Low/forward torso carriage is preserved across the reviewed walk and trot phases.
Forepaws visibly plant beneath the chest and recover, rather than remaining suspended as unused arms.
Hind hocks remain folded and participate in the cycle; the upright bipedal silhouette is absent.
Both side and three-quarter views were inspected to reduce far-limb occlusion ambiguity.
No obvious chest/limb mesh collapse, floor pop, or wrap discontinuity appears in the reviewed sequences.
Stance movement against the stationary translated grid shows no obvious skating at the demonstrated calibrated speeds.
assessment: Passed asset-level posture/contact sequence review. The style reads as a low deliberate walk/scurry, not a photorealistic rabbit hopping gait.
